name: Namikawa Tokimune
source:
The protagonist's friend.

He has a bright and lighthearted personality. He is friendly, but his frequent dirty jokes tend to put off the girls. He has feelings for Miyuki and intends to hide it, though its obvious to her.
He also serves as Seiichi's counselor.

[Translated from [url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc044/character.html]the official site[/url]]
